newsitem.title: POLAND: Investment risk on decline in Poland - institute.
newsitem.headline: Investment risk on decline in Poland - institute.

text.p: Investment risk in the majority of Poland's industry and service sectors declined in 1996 as firms found and filled new market niches created by a growing economy, an independent economic think-tank said on Thursday.

"Overall investment risk fell as the economy grew, firms restructured and the economic climate remained positive," Bohdan Wyznikiewicz, deputy chief of the Institute of Market Economic Research (IBnGR) told a news conference.

The IBnGR said investment risk in sectors such as computer production and medical services fell most significantly in 1996 while exposure to high-risk coal mining became even more dangerous last year. It gave no sector forecasts for this year.

The Gdansk-based institute categorised nearly 300 industry, construction and services sectors into five risk categories on the basis of 20 criteria including firm effectiveness, structural and systematic changes.
